Result: 0 blockers at all five widths — 1100 offscreen chars 105 to 0, full five-column comparison table; residual MAJORs (jammed logo row, truncated footer Connect column, frozen 700 mobile tree) share one root: other frozen box properties (margins, footer tracks) not yet covered by the unfreeze set.
